definition: Maia and Marco are artificial intelligence used by GMA Network.
details: Unveiled in 2023, they are used to fulfill the role of sports newscasters.
story: Imagine a factory floor where each workstation can glance at every other workstation before doing its part. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. Structure decides what the model can even express — the blueprint before the bricks. That blueprint is Maia and Marco.
